import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a clean seaborn style for better aesthetics
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between key sleep metrics
# X-axis: Sleep Duration (hours)
# Y-axis: Quality of Sleep (on a scale of 1-10)
# Hue (color): Stress Level (will use a color gradient)
# Size: Physical Activity Level (will use marker size to represent activity)
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(100, 1000), # Define the range of marker sizes for better visibility
    palette='viridis', # Choose a color palette for the hue (Stress Level)
    alpha=0.8, # Set transparency for points
    legend='full' # Display full legend for both hue and size
)

# Add informative title and axis labels
plt.title('Relationship between Sleep Duration, Quality, Stress, and Physical Activity', fontsize=16)
